title: Markets in Flux: Inflation, the Fed and Holiday Volatility
summary: What could keep markets moving through the holidays? Scott Bauer of Prosper Trading Academy joins Jeff Praissman to break down inflation, upcoming Fed expectations, NVIDIA and AI-related volatility, jobs data, consumer spending, and the indicators investors may want to watch heading into year-end.
